contributions.detail: THE SUB-$50 TRAP IS INVERTED ON THIS FILING AND THE CORE BRIEF'S DEFAULT BASIS WOULD HAVE MANUFACTURED A FALSE MISMATCH, SO THE BASIS WAS DERIVED FROM THE PAGE. This filer did NOT restrict Form A to contributions over $50: he itemized EVERY contribution, small ones included, so the schedule's scope is line 1 PLUS line 2, not line 1 alone. The 16 emitted rows sum to exactly 1135.00 = 260 + 875. Better still, the split proves the filer TRANSPOSED his own two cover lines, and the proof is arithmetic, not impression: the rows GREATER than $50 (100.00 + 75.00 + 100.00 + 200.00 + 400.00) sum to exactly 875, which sits in the cover's line 2 cell (the '$50.00 or less' aggregate), while the rows of $50 OR LESS (10 + 20 + 25 + 25 + 25 + 25 + 10 + 50 + 25 + 25 + 20) sum to exactly 260, which sits in the cover's line 1 cell ('donors who gave more than $50.00'). Both subsets close to the cent, crosswise, which no coincidence produces. Per the contract NEITHER stated total is recomputed or overwritten: both are recorded verbatim in the anchors exactly where the filer wrote them, and the transposition is reported rather than repaired. Scope is cumulative: line 1 and line 2 both read 0 in the LAST column and the THIS and CUMULATIVE cells are equal, so this is the only report of the cycle and the two scopes coincide.

expenditures.detail: 8 itemized rows sum to exactly 925.31 = cover line 3, THIS and CUMULATIVE alike (LAST reads 0). The gate settled two glyphs that vision alone left open, which is the Rhodes rule working as intended: row 6 could be read 80.22 or 90.22 and row 2's cents were overwritten, and ONLY the combination 80.22 + 7.37 closes -- both were then confirmed by 1200 dpi crops (row 6's leading glyph is an unmistakable double-loop 8). NOTE ON THE CUMULATIVE CELL: the filer first wrote 309.69 there (his balance figure, belonging on line 4), struck it through, and wrote 925.31 above it. Both are recorded -- the surviving figure as cover_expense_cum and the struck one as cover_expense_cum_struck -- and neither is silently dropped.

gates.page_subtotal: The Carr 5-5-PG prints no schedule total and no page subtotal on either sheet, and this filer added none of his own, so the cover block is the only anchor. Form A gate: p2 rows 1135.00 = cover line 1 + line 2 = 260 + 875, EXACT, with both subsets closing crosswise as described in recon.contributions. Form B gate: p3 rows 925.31 = cover line 3 CUMULATIVE 925.31, EXACT.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py returns no usable grid on either schedule page here (the heavy blue ballpoint crosses the printed rules through the whole inked region, which is the same failure it shows on every Carr sheet in this chunk), so it is reported rather than relied on. Counted by ink at 200 dpi and cross-checked against the date and amount columns cropped separately at 600 dpi: p2 carries SEVENTEEN inked ledger lines, of which line 15 is struck through end to end in a single stroke across all four columns and carries no amount -- a voided entry, not a transaction -- so 16 rows are emitted and the line numbering skips it (emitted 15 = physical 16, emitted 16 = physical 17). p3 carries 8 inked lines and 8 rows are emitted. The independent column crops matched the page count on both sheets: 17 date cells and 16 amounts on p2, 8 and 8 on p3.

Measured pitch 2.19 pct (p2) and 2.26 pct (p3) of page height, taken from the ink.
gates.balance_chain: IT DOES NOT CLOSE, AND THE MISS IS EXACTLY 100.00 -- filer arithmetic, reported not repaired. Contributions 1135.00 minus expenses 925.31 = 209.69, but cover line 4 reads 309.69 in BOTH the THIS and the CUMULATIVE column. Every input to that subtraction is independently confirmed here (the contribution rows gate to 1135.00, the expenditure rows gate to 925.31), so the error is in the filer's own balance line and not in either schedule. The LAST column reads 0 on all four lines, so the beginning balance is a stated zero and there is no prior filing to chain to; no other filing by this candidate is in this chunk.

escalation_note: p2 date column and amount column each re-read as two 600 dpi bands; three dates re-escalated to 1200 dpi (the scribbled day on row 13, the empty day on row 14, the year glyph on row 15). p3 amount column re-read as one 600 dpi band and row 6 re-escalated to 1200 dpi (the 8/9 discrimination the gate depended on). Cover totals block read at 400 dpi. Six 600 dpi single-cell geometry-proof crops.
notes: index.csv calls this Jennifer Roark / County Council / 2018 and the cover agrees and is fuller: 'Full Name of Candidate JENNIFER JEAN ROARK', 'Name of Office CACHE COUNTY COUNCIL', 'Office District 3', 'Political Party DEMOCRATS', addressed 'TO CACHE COUNTY' (the clerk's name is not written, only the county). IN SCOPE (county office). THE DOCUMENT CONTRADICTS THE CHUNK FILE ON DATE: the chunk row says 2018-10-17, but the signature line reads '10/12/18' and the clerk's stamp reads 'CLERK OCT 12 18 PM 4:13:15' -- two marks say 12 October 2018. Transcribed from the form and flagged. TWO FILER CORRECTIONS ON THE COVER, both preserved: line 3's CUMULATIVE cell has a struck 309.69 with 925.31 written above it, and line 4's cells carry the filer's circled initials. A WHOLE LEDGER LINE IS VOIDED on p2 (physical line 15: Jonathan Kirby at [street address discarded at read time per PRIVACY.md], the address that belongs to the line-13 donor) -- struck end to end and left without an amount, evidently a mis-entry the filer redid on the next line with a different address; it is NOT emitted as a row and NOT counted, and the line numbering is documented in row_count_gate. Two donors appear twice (Karina Brown on 9/9 and 9/11, two separate 25.00-and-50.00 gifts) and one contribution comes from the candidate's own street address -- both are normal and transcribed verbatim; the downstream normalizer types self-funding. PRIVACY: the cover prints the candidate's home street address, ZIP and home phone, and Form A prints a street address for all sixteen donors, three of them out-of-state -- every street, suite, PO box and ZIP is discarded at read time. Where the filer wrote no city (six rows), donor_city is left BLANK rather than inferred from the ZIP, including the three out-of-state ZIPs.
